lines.zh: 轻盈跃动，如幻影般飘渺。
lines.en: Flickers like a ghost, leaping lightly.

lines.zh: 闪烁着神秘的光芒，如梦如幻。
lines.en: Shimmers with mystic light, dreamlike and surreal.

lines.zh: 跳跃间，散发出魔法的气息。
lines.en: Magic lingers in its every leap.

lines.zh: 在空中划出一道魔法的轨迹。
lines.en: Traces a magical path through the air.

lines.zh: 翅膀轻拍，如同夜风般柔和。
lines.en: Wings softly flutter, like a gentle night breeze.

lines.zh: 尾翼轻摇，带来魔法的温暖。
lines.en: Tails sway, bringing a warm spell.

lines.zh: 轻盈地在空中飞翔，仿佛来自另一个世界。
lines.en: Fades through the air, as if from another realm.

lines.zh: 飘忽不定，如同魔法精灵。
跳跃中带起一阵魔法波动。
在空中舞动，轻盈而优雅。
lines.en: Dances in the air, graceful and light.

lines.zh: 长耳一抖，跃过胡萝卜田。
lines.en: Ears twitching, it bounds over the carrot field.

lines.zh: 金冠在月光下晃了一下。
lines.en: Its golden crown sways in the moonlight.

lines.zh: 静止不动，似乎在等待什么。
凝视着远处，闪烁着智慧的光芒。
lines.en: Stares distant, wisdom shining in its gaze.

lines.zh: 轻巧地漂浮在空中，享受着宁静。
翅膀轻拂，似乎在梳理羽毛。
lines.en: Brushes wings, as if grooming its feathers.

lines.zh: 轻盈地摆动着尾翼，享受着自由。
在空中缓缓旋转，享受着飞行。
静止如雕塑，眼神中藏着秘密。
lines.en: Stands like a sculpture, eyes holding secrets.

lines.zh: 轻巧地漂浮，仿佛不受重力束缚。
lines.en: Puts up a flight, defying gravity.

lines.zh: 静静栖息，眼中闪烁着好奇。
lines.en: Rests quietly, eyes full of curiosity.

lines.zh: 卡萝特啃着一根胡萝卜。
卡萝特用后腿搔着耳朵。
lines.en: Karot scratches its ear with a hind leg.

lines.zh: 卡萝特望着自己的兔子兵。

lines.en: The grass by its throne lies flattened.
My rabbits come the moment I call.

lines.zh: 忽然注意到玩家，眼中闪过好奇。
lines.en: Notices the player, eyes glinting with curiosity.

lines.zh: 飞向玩家，翅膀轻轻拍打。
lines.en: Flies toward the player, wings softly beating.

lines.zh: 翅膀轻轻扇动，靠近玩家。
lines.en: Wings flutter as it approaches the player.
Wings dance as it draws near.

lines.zh: 飞到玩家附近，轻拍翅膀。
轻巧地降落在玩家身边。

lines.en: I hover and size you up.

lines.zh: 轻巧地降落，与玩家眼神交流。
lines.en: Descends lightly, exchanging glances with the player.
The king's gaze settles on you.
It tilts its head, weighing you.
Karot rises and shakes off grass.

lines.zh: 你的到来打断了它的餐。
卡萝特受了伤，看起来不太妙。
lines.en: Karot is hurt, not looking good.

lines.zh: 卡萝特身上有伤，快帮帮忙。
卡萝特伤痕累累，快治疗。
卡萝特受伤了，别让它倒下。
lines.en: Karot is hurt, don’t let it fall.

lines.zh: 卡萝特受伤了，小心别倒地。
lines.en: Karot is injured, don’t let it fall.

lines.zh: 卡萝特受伤了，小心别淹死。
lines.en: Karot is injured, don’t let it drown.

lines.zh: 卡萝特受伤了，小心别爆炸。
lines.en: Karot is injured, don’t let it explode.

lines.zh: 卡萝特受伤了，小心别中箭。
lines.en: Karot is injured, don’t let it get hit by arrows.

lines.zh: 卡萝特受伤了，小心别中魔法。
lines.en: Karot is injured, don’t let it get hit by magic.

lines.zh: 你身上的光芒吸引了我，卡萝特！
lines.en: The light on you draws me, Karot!

lines.zh: 你手中的魔豆是我的美食！
lines.en: Those beans in your hand are my treat!

lines.zh: 这根胡萝卜，我和兔子们分。
lines.en: This carrot I'll split with my rabbits.

lines.zh: 跟我交换吧，我有你需要的！
lines.en: Trade with me, I have what you need!
You have my kin inside you!
You've entered the circle I patrol.
My rabbit troops aren't all here yet.
You fit to be my partner!

lines.zh: 你是我命中注定的伙伴！
咬下一块我身上的肉吧！
lines.en: Taste a piece of my flesh!

lines.zh: 我的兔子兵，马上就出来。
lines.en: My rabbit soldiers are coming out.
I flap my wings and climb higher.

lines.zh: 一千二百五十点生命，够打。
lines.en: Twelve hundred fifty health. Enough to fight.

lines.zh: 你将在我的力量下颤抖！
lines.en: You will tremble under my power!
Your fate will be decided by me!
Whiskers twitch; it readies a charge.
Hind legs dig in; turf flies.
One cry calls in its helpers.
I shriek and claw your shoulder.
My power comes from the darkness!
My talons rake across your face.
The rabbits part; the king steps out.

lines.zh: 生气的兔子在身后列队。
lines.en: Angry rabbits line up behind me.

lines.zh: 我的胡萝卜田不欢迎你。
lines.en: My carrot field doesn't welcome you.
Karot is hit by an arrow.
